source_selection.method: First ten currently observed outdoor and ten currently observed indoor locations whose IDs match the retained first metadata page, excluding the indoor location whose public coordinates are exactly longitude 2 / latitude 1.
source_selection.candidate_pages: Four original page-1 responses of 100 items each are retained in public/outdoor and public/indoor.

attribution.location_metadata: Original licenses/licenseDetails/provider/dataSource/dataSourceDetail/owner/timezone values remain in each location source.

interpretation.source: Actual retained public Map responses for these twenty or fewer selected public Location IDs.
interpretation.roster: Candidate page-1 responses are retained for selection; they are not a complete global roster.
interpretation.privacy: Indoor coordinates are the provider's coarse public coordinates; no address or building is inferred.
interpretation.values: Original provider record objects and zero-based source_row positions are retained below. Decimal strings and nulls are unchanged.
interpretation.coverage: Coverage is valid reported values divided by all expected hours for each requested measure.
interpretation.mean: Means are unweighted arithmetic means of available provider hourly aggregates, presented to six decimals.
interpretation.processing: No interpolation, zero fill, health classification, unit conversion or second provider correction is applied.
interpretation.missing: NO_BUCKET means no returned hourly bucket. NULL is an explicit null in a returned bucket; ABSENT_FIELD and INVALID remain separate.
interpretation.selection: Outdoor history contains only its explicitly requested measure; other CSV measures are NOT_REQUESTED.
interpretation.range: Catalogue range excursions are counted and retained, without clamping or exclusion.
interpretation.csv: Numeric cells are normalized finite numbers. Text beginning with spreadsheet formula prefixes receives a leading apostrophe; original text remains in JSON/source.
